name: Company signal book
description: Their private codes, taken from a Company captain's cabin. You read their signals before their hunters do: the Company hunt grows 40% slower.

name: Disgraced Company factor
description: Sacked for his honesty, or so he says. He knows what every cargo is worth and every merchant's price: +25% prize gold, prices 15% lower.

name: Deserted Royal Marines
description: A file of redcoats who'd had enough of the lash. Your people fight 30% harder hand to hand, boarding or repelling.

name: Carronades
description: Short, ugly Navy smashers, light enough to mount anywhere. +1 gun a side.

name: The black flag
description: The Brotherhood's own colours. Every crew knows what it means: their hands work 15% slower, shaking at their guns.

name: Brotherhood grapple men
description: Old hands who've thrown a thousand hooks. Grapples are 50% more likely to catch.

name: Fire pots
description: Clay pots of pitch and sulphur, slung from the yards. Every hit on her hull has an extra 10% chance to start a fire.

name: Swivel guns
description: Little guns on the rail, loaded with musket balls. In battle they pick off her hands, and now and then a specialist, like a second sniper.

name: Long sweeps
description: Great oars, built for running down the helpless. Your escape fills 40% faster, and ships running from you escape 40% slower.

name: Clipper rig
description: A slaver's sharp-built rig, made to outrun the Navy. +5% dodge.
